column1: # ai-models.tsv — the local models `vikix ai models` offers (Ollama names).
# GB is the download (Ollama's registry, 2026-09-28); memory in use is a
# little more. BILLIONS decides how it runs on a CPU: up to 2 fast, up to
# 4 well, up to 8 slowly; bigger isn't offered. A line is a model: add or
# remove one here, and the picker follows.
